title: Seasonal Vitamin D Atlas
subtitle: Global Serum 25-Hydroxyvitamin D Levels
description: Population mean serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations from national surveys and published studies. Values are standardised to nmol/L. Seasonal interpolation uses a sinusoidal model between measured summer (Jun–Aug) and winter (Dec–Feb) values.
about: Built for chronobiology research. Data compiled from three exhaustive literature searches covering national health surveys (NHANES, NDNS, CHMS, DEGS1, KiGGS, KNHANES, ENSANUT, NHES, TILDA, StatusD, Tromsø), the VDSP-standardised European pooled dataset (Cashman et al. 2016), and regional cohort studies across 39 countries. Southern Hemisphere entries have inverted phase. Some Gulf-state data shows paradoxical winter > summer values due to summer sun-avoidance behaviour.
